tldr: Chiron transiting the 8th house: a long healing chapter around intimacy, shared resources, debt, grief, secrecy, and deep trust.
body: Chiron moving through the 8th house can reopen old material around intimacy, shared resources, debt, grief, secrecy, and deep trust. This is usually a long season, not a quick event, and it asks for patient work with the sore place rather than a rushed fix. The wound is in intimacy, trust, and shared resources; loss, debt, or betrayal cut deep here.
business: For a year or more, the Chiron wound works through intimacy, shared resources, debt, grief, secrecy, and deep trust. You guide others through crisis, grief, and what stays hidden.
shadow: Guarding everything, or merging too completely to feel safe.
advice: Tend the sore spot in the 8th house deliberately. Work with intimacy, shared resources, debt, grief, secrecy, and deep trust as a healing chapter, not a crisis to fix fast.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
